snippet.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Long Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order are open: https://www.focus-entmt.com/games/resonance-a-plague-tale-legacy#shop?utm_campaign=RAPTL_LongGameplay&utm_medium=post&utm_source=YouTube#buy

Step into 7 minutes of gameplay from Resonance: #APlagueTale Legacy, coming August 27. 🗡️

Rely on your agility to overcome deadly enemies: unleash powerful strikes, master your arsenal, and navigate treacherous puzzles steeped in Minoan myths.
